Freedom fighters, razakars cannot coexist
2018-07-31T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/freedom-fighters-razakars-cannot-coexist-1613794

Looking back on the history of Liberation War in 1971 is a must to realise whether the country is moving forward on the right track, said Information Minister Hasanul Haq Inu yesterday.

“Freedom fighters and razakars cannot coexist as it is against the spirit of Liberation War,” he said.

He slammed the political parties that made alliance with those against the spirit.

As chief guest, the minister was launching a book titled “Phire Dekha Ekattor” [looking back '71] at a publication ceremony at Jatiya Press Club.

Written by noted journalist Abu Sayeed Khan, the book was published by Shrabon Prokashani. The writer depicted various aspects and political thoughts regarding the war.

Addressing the programme, historian Prof Syed Anwar Husain urged people to correct themselves if they are displaced from the war spirit.

Communist Party of Bangladesh President Mujahidul Islam Selim, DU Associate Professor Robaet Ferdous and Shrabon Prokashani Publisher Robin Ahsan also spoke at the event.
